title: Settings
subtitle: Preview appearance changes, then save when you are ready.
unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Appearance preview reverts if you leave without saving.
generalDescription: Service credentials and portable launcher presets.

service.title: Service connections
service.description: Use credentials registered for this project. Tokens and service keys are encrypted by the system.
service.clientIdPlaceholder: Client ID from your app registration
service.keyConfiguredPlaceholder: Encrypted key saved; leave blank to keep it

preset.title: Configuration presets
preset.description: Export or import launcher settings. Accounts, login tokens, and service keys are never included.

appearanceDescription: Language and appearance preview immediately. Save to keep them.
soundDescription: Off by default. Used only for important transitions.

background.title: Home background
background.description: Choose a local PNG, JPEG, or WebP image. Content above it keeps a stable contrast layer.

gameDescription: Shared game files and window defaults. Instance overrides stay in instance settings.

game.isolationDescription: Keep saves, mods, and settings separate for each game version.

javaDescription: Choose the shared runtime and launch defaults for new instances.

java.autoDescription: Download and verify the matching official runtime when needed.

downloadDescription: Control official downloads, mirrors, and task throughput.

downloadSource.officialDescription: Download only from Mojang/Minecraft addresses, with size and SHA-1 verification.
downloadSource.autoDescription: Try official addresses first, then BMCLAPI for vanilla metadata, clients, libraries, and assets.
downloadSource.bmclapiDescription: Try BMCLAPI's version_manifest_v2 first, then official addresses. Verification requirements stay the same.
downloadSource.mirrorNotice: BMCLAPI is a community mirror, not an official Mojang service. A manifest hash proves file consistency, not independent official endorsement.
downloadSource.scopeNotice: This does not add mirrors for Quilt, Modrinth, CurseForge, or other Maven services. Fixed files are verified before writing.

aboutDescription: Version, license, source code, and local-data behavior.

about.dataNotice: Uninstall keeps launcher data by default. Removing an account or instance registration does not delete game files.
about.secretNotice: Presets exclude accounts, login tokens, and service keys. Service credentials are configured in General.

notice.secretSaved: CurseForge key saved with system encryption.
notice.presetExported: Preset exported without accounts or service keys.
notice.javaNotFound: No Java environment found. Install one or enter its path.

config.backgroundInvalid: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP background no larger than 12 MB.
config.presetInvalid: Choose a valid preset exported by this launcher.
config.busy: Wait for the current installation or launch preparation to finish before changing settings.
config.gameDirectory: The game directory must be an absolute path.
config.invalid: Some settings are invalid. Review the highlighted values and try again.
